'''''Fortune and Glory''''' was a [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|Personal Luxury Yacht 3000]] owned by the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], which bore his [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|symbol]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
The ''Fortune and Glory'' was owned by [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], leader of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]].<ref name="TCW:TP" /> The [[Starship/Legends|starship]] bore his symbol during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="SW.com trivia" /> Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Darth Maul date">''[[Star Wars: Darth Maul — Death Sentence]]'' places the [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] revival arc around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], which takes place around the episode ''[[Tipping Points]]''.</ref> Ohnaka used the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to deliver [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]] to the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]], who were fighting [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TCW:TP">{{TCW|Tipping Points}}</ref> The yacht was later kept in a hidden [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] in a canyon near [[Hondo's complex/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's pirate outpost]].<ref name="TCW:ANB">{{TCW|A Necessary Bond}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Fortune and Glory'' first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|Season Five]] episode ''[[Tipping Points]]''. The ship's concept art was designed by [[Wayne Lo]].<ref name="SW.com trivia" />

"Fortune and Glory" is a reference to the film [[Wikipedia:Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom|''Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom'']], in which [[Indiana Jones]] and [[Short Round]] say they're after "fortune and glory."<ref name="SW.com trivia" />
